captions.detailed: An immersion hand blender consisting of a long, cylindrical black motor handle with a rounded top and a side-mounted black trigger. The bottom of the handle connects to a detachable grey metallic blending shaft with a flared bell guard at the tip. The handle, trigger, and shaft are designed with mechanical joints, allowing the trigger to pivot, the shaft to twist-lock onto the base, and the internal blade to rotate.
captions.instruction: Create an articulated 3D model of an immersion hand blender with a cylindrical black motor handle, a side-mounted trigger button on a revolute pivot, and a detachable grey metallic blending shaft that connects via a twist-lock revolute joint.
captions.factory: Construct the main handle body as a cylinder with rounded ends using CadQuery primitives. Model the trigger as a thin box attached to the side of the handle body via a revolute joint. Build the detachable blending shaft using a series of cylinders and a lofted cone to form the bell guard, attaching it to the handle base with a revolute twist-lock coupling. Apply a matte black material to the handle and trigger, and a metallic grey finish to the blending shaft.
